name: What is crown molding and why should I install it?

mainEntity.name: What is crown molding and why should I install it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding is a decorative trim that bridges the wall and ceiling, adding architectural detail and elegance to a room. It can enhance the perceived value of your home, conceal minor imperfections where walls meet the ceiling, and provide a finished look to any space. Beyond aesthetics, it can protect wall edges from dings. When considering installation, think about the overall style of your home and the desired visual impact; different profiles and sizes create distinct effects. We help clients in Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, and Kuna select designs that complement their homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crown molding is a decorative trim at the wall-ceiling junction that adds elegance and can hide imperfections, enhancing your home's finished look.
